about.title: About CTF Platform
about.metaDesc: Learn about our CTF training platform
about.intro1: CTF Platform is a comprehensive training environment designed to help cybersecurity enthusiasts and professionals develop their skills through hands-on Capture The Flag challenges.
about.intro2: Our platform offers a wide range of challenges across multiple categories including binary exploitation, cryptography, forensics, reverse engineering, and web exploitation. Whether you're a beginner just starting your cybersecurity journey or an experienced professional looking to sharpen your skills, we have challenges suited to your level.
about.missionDesc: To provide accessible, high-quality cybersecurity training that prepares individuals for real-world security challenges.
about.communityDesc: Join a supportive space where learners and experts come together to discuss challenges, share insights, and help each other grow in cybersecurity.
about.skillsDesc: Our challenges are based on actual security scenarios, ensuring you develop practical skills applicable in the field.
about.learningDesc: New challenges are added regularly, keeping content fresh and aligned with the latest security trends and techniques.
about.point1: Structured learning paths that guide you from beginner to advanced levels
about.point2: Detailed writeups to help you learn from each challenge
about.point3: Competitive scoring system with leaderboards to track your progress
about.point4: Regular CTF competitions and events to test your skills
about.point5: Active community forums for discussion and collaboration

help.title: Help Center
help.forumDesc: Connect with other users and get help
help.a1: Create a free account and start with beginner challenges in the category of your choice.
help.a2: A flag is a secret string proving you solved a challenge, usually in the format flag{...}.
help.a3: Each challenge has a point value based on difficulty. Solve challenges to earn points and climb the leaderboard.
help.a4: Many challenges include hints. Revealing a hint may reduce the points you earn.
help.a5: Click Forgot password on the login page and follow the instructions.
help.a6: No sharing of flags, no attacking the platform infrastructure, and be respectful to others.
help.contactText: Have a question? Reach out to our support team.
